title: Start with a bounded question in chat
summary: Ask a direct question, add facts, and refine the reply. A small example makes wrong guesses easy to spot.

intro.what: Ask a direct question, add facts, and refine the reply. A small example makes wrong guesses easy to spot.
intro.features: Turn these notes into two lines. Label one Observed and one Unknown. Did delivery succeed?
intro.exchange: Use a fictional mail handoff to test this surface.
intro.m365: Apply the same check to an approved practice note.
intro.developer: Try the example with a small local project.

sections.title: Where it stops
paragraphs: A chat cannot confirm an event that is missing from your notes. Ask for unknown when the record ends.

sections.title: Plan and availability
paragraphs: Usage depends on the model, features, length of the chat and the complexity of the request. Check the limits page for the account you plan to use.

sections.title: Best first example
paragraphs: Delivery attempt at 08:04. Retry started at 08:06. No final result was recorded.
Turn these notes into two lines. Label one Observed and one Unknown. Did delivery succeed?
Check your result. Observed includes the attempt and retry. Unknown covers final delivery.

paragraphs: Note A says the pilot begins Tuesday. Note B says the wider rollout date is undecided.
Select both notes. Ask when the pilot starts and when everyone joins. Ask for a citation for each answer.

title: Edit and test a page in Canvas
summary: Use Canvas to draft a document or build and revise an app alongside the chat. Try one interaction before adding features.

intro.what: Use Canvas to draft a document or build and revise an app alongside the chat. Try one interaction before adding features.
intro.features: In Canvas, build the bag counter with a number visible at all times. Try Add bag twice and Start over once.
intro.exchange: Test a pretend queue counter with zero messages.
intro.m365: Try two rows from a fictional request list.
intro.developer: Run the smallest working screen before adding another feature.
sources: Create docs, apps & more with Canvas - Computer - Gemini Apps Help

sections.title: Where it stops
paragraphs: A shared Canvas link does not by itself deliver a standalone offline app. Test a saved local file separately if that is your goal.
sources: Create docs, apps & more with Canvas - Computer - Gemini Apps Help

sections.title: Plan and availability
paragraphs: Canvas requires sign-in. Google says adding AI to a Canvas app requires the user to be at least 18. Shared Canvas content opens in the web app.
sources: Create docs, apps & more with Canvas - Computer - Gemini Apps Help

sections.title: Best first example
paragraphs: Make a small page that counts packed bags. It needs Add bag and Start over.
In Canvas, build the bag counter with a number visible at all times. Try Add bag twice and Start over once.
Check your result. The page visits 0, 1, 2 and 0.
sources: Create docs, apps & more with Canvas - Computer - Gemini Apps Help

title: Work on files with Antigravity
summary: Use the Antigravity coding agent for a project with files. Give it one change, then review the patch and run the result.

intro.what: Use the Antigravity coding agent for a project with files. Give it one change, then review the patch and run the result.
intro.features: Open a practice folder. Build a score summary for both inputs. Show which files changed and run both checks.
intro.exchange: Test a pretend queue counter with zero messages.
intro.m365: Try two rows from a fictional request list.
intro.developer: Run the smallest working screen before adding another feature.

sections.title: Where it stops
paragraphs: A passing example cannot cover every input. Test both an empty list and a list containing zero.

sections.title: Plan and availability
paragraphs: Personal access and rate limits depend on the Google AI plan. Workspace plans do not include the personal Antigravity plan. The desktop setup guide lists supported systems.
Not verified — 2026-11-22: a fixed number of agent runs per account.

sections.title: Best first example
paragraphs: An empty score list should say No plays. A list with a single zero should show 0.
Open a practice folder. Build a score summary for both inputs. Show which files changed and run both checks.
Check your result. The empty list gets a message. The real zero stays visible.

unverified: A fixed number of agent runs per account.
